description: This file defines the PossibleNextRepaymentCalculationServiceDiscovery class, which is a Spring service responsible for discovering and returning a suitable PossibleNextRepaymentCalculationService instance for a given Loan object by filtering a list of registered services.

classes.name: PossibleNextRepaymentCalculationServiceDiscovery
classes.description: A Spring service that finds and provides an appropriate PossibleNextRepaymentCalculationService for a given Loan.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns a PossibleNextRepaymentCalculationService instance that can accept the provided Loan, or null if none is suitable.
